bias.zh: 偏空 · 回落至 $854–858 低点区

read.en: Micron fell 6.3% on Oct 22 to $856.49, trading between $849.25 and $908.30. It is below the falling 5-day ($890.0), 10-day ($926.7), 30-day ($999.3) and 100-day ($974.7) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($729.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($985.51), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: 美光 10月22日下跌 6.3%，收于 $856.49，盘中区间 $849.25–908.30。股价位于下行的 5 日（$890.0）、10 日（$926.7）、30 日（$999.3）和 100 日均线（$974.7）下方，仍在上行的 200 日均线（$729.4）上方。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$985.51），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The drop broke the $903–905 and $881.5–889.5 supports, now resistance, and closed in the $854–858 zone (Jun 9 and Oct 15 lows). Resistance is $858, then $881.5–890 (Oct 20–21 lows, 5-day) and $903–905. Support is $849–854, then $804 (Jul 17 low) and $730–738 (200-day, Jul 29 low). A close below $849 would open $804; a close above $890 would target $905.
